name: duplicate-usage-deltas
invariant: Deltas are deduplicated by (call, sequence): a repeat counts once, also after the call's final, and one call's sequence never deduplicates another's; equal figures at two sequences both count; a delta unseen until after a final raises the call above it and is flagged inconsistent_usage, in either arrival order; a conflicting repeat keeps the larger, flagged, in either order. Whole figures and uncertainty are asserted (05 "Usage and settlement").
